intro: Today's briefing covers Armenia's growing international cultural profile, high-level diplomatic engagement with India, domestic infrastructure and energy challenges, and notable achievements in sports.

topics.title: Robert Plant to perform in Armenia in 2027
topics.text: Led Zeppelin frontman Robert Plant is scheduled to perform in Armenia for the first time in September 2027. The concert was announced by multiple Armenian news outlets.

sources.title: Led Zeppelin’s Robert Plant to Perform in Armenia in September 2027
Led Zeppelin legend Robert Plant to perform in Armenia for first time in 2027

topics.title: Pashinyan holds talks with Indian Foreign Minister in New Delhi
topics.text: Prime Minister Nikol Pashinyan met with Indian External Affairs Minister S. Jaishankar in New Delhi to discuss bilateral cooperation. The Armenian Deputy Foreign Minister also highlighted the role of La Francophonie as a platform for dialogue.

sources.title: Armenian Deputy FM highlights La Francophonie’s role as platform for dialogue and cooperation
Pashinyan meets Indian FM in New Delhi

topics.title: Armenia named a top travel destination for 2027
topics.text: Condé Nast Traveller Middle East included Armenia among its 27 best places to visit in 2027. The recognition highlights the country's growing appeal to international tourists.

sources.title: Armenia named among 27 best places to visit in 2027 by Condé Nast Traveller Middle East

topics.title: Solar energy boom reveals power grid deficiencies
topics.text: Armenia's rapid expansion of solar energy capacity has exposed costly gaps in the national power grid infrastructure. The government also allocated $5.5 million for the expansion of the Yerevan metro system this week.

sources.title: Armenia's solar boom exposes costly gaps in its power grid
Armenia to allocate $5.5M for Yerevan metro expansion: THIS WEEK IN BUSINESS

topics.title: Armenian athletes secure international medals
topics.text: Nare Isakhanyan won a silver medal at the European Championships, fulfilling a promise of international success. In chess, Haik Martirosyan outperformed world champion Magnus Carlsen over two games.

sources.title: Nare Isakhanyan fulfills promise of international success with European silver medal
Armenia's Haik Martirosyan outperforms Magnus Carlsen over two games

topics.title: Armenia and Russia sign cultural cooperation program
topics.text: The two countries signed a cultural cooperation program covering the years 2027 to 2029. The agreement aims to strengthen ties in the cultural sphere.

sources.title: Armenia, Russia sign 2027–2029 cultural cooperation program

topics.title: Prosecutors seek criminal proceedings against two judges
topics.text: The Prosecutor General's Office has requested consent to initiate criminal proceedings against two judges. Separately, the Police Guard reported uncovering around 1,000 crimes over the past year.

sources.title: Police Guard uncovers around 1,000 crimes in one year, ensures security at major events
Prosecutors seek consent to initiate criminal proceedings against two judges
